_doc: Replication Ledger: what could stop it within a year of no input, and the safeguard for each. Test probes name a test in worker/*.test.mjs. Platform-wide faults (Actions outages, GitHub and Cloudflare incidents, Node end of life) are covered by doctrine/yearsim.json and apply to this Worker too.

risks.what: a standing is typed by hand and drifts from its evidence
risks.safeguard: standings are computed by standing.js at request time; the validator refuses a typed standing
risks.probe: test:a typed standing, a number in a summary, or a duplicate paper is refused

risks.what: a standing changes with no record
risks.safeguard: cli.mjs add appends every change with the paper that moved it to data/changes.jsonl
risks.probe: test:adding a replication recomputes the standing and logs the move

risks.what: a DOI is mistyped or a title drifts from the registry
risks.safeguard: cli.mjs verify resolves every DOI at Crossref and compares title and year; new attempts take their citation from Crossref by DOI
risks.probe: test:Crossref metadata becomes a citation and mismatches are caught

risks.what: the model that labels candidates is retired
risks.safeguard: standings need no model; candidates wait unread when no model answers
the Worker holds no secret; Crossref and OpenAlex are open
